RFA_LectureHall.name: Fleet Academy reciprocal-field lecture theater
RFA_LectureHall.text: Tiered but intimate Academy room in mature Fleet blue, white and restrained gold. A large volumetric map can be rotated from star-map scale to beacon-line and cross-sectional views. Students can walk into the projection rather than merely watch a screen.

RFA_InversionLab.name: Fleet Academy inversion laboratory
RFA_InversionLab.text: Hands-on teaching lab with safe low-energy reciprocal-field visualizers, transparent test volumes, phase controls and a suspended ship model. The apparatus makes invisible gradients legible without implying that a real transit field is being generated inside the building.

RFA_BHA_Gallery.name: Beacon Harmonics Authority service gallery
RFA_BHA_Gallery.text: Operational maintenance platform overlooking a real or full-scale training beacon assembly: detector racks, redundant sensor channels, service housings, hard access rails and restrained status lights. Green and red appear as instrument states, not decorative faction lighting.

RFA_SurveyDock.name: Academy survey dock
RFA_SurveyDock.text: Working Fleet dock where purple survey craft, instrument pods and yellow maintenance tenders are serviced. It should feel like an expedition yard rather than a ceremonial hangar; equipment cases, calibration rigs and tired crews matter as much as ship silhouettes.

RFA_RouteExchange.name: Route-market simulation room
RFA_RouteExchange.text: Academy case-study space that reconstructs private route trading through layered charts, timestamps, provenance chains and buyer paths. Visualize information changing hands without turning the room into a generic cyberpunk data wall.

RFA_StrategyGallery.name: Fleet Academy strategic transit gallery
RFA_StrategyGallery.text: Large-scale route map linking Core and Verge worlds, with selectable overlays for Fleet patrol, Shard reach, survey traces, maintenance assets and ship traditions. The geography should remain readable as infrastructure first and military map second.

RFA_SimBridge.name: Fleet Academy transit simulation bridge
RFA_SimBridge.text: Full training bridge with navigation, engineering, BHA-status and command stations facing a shared corridor display. It reproduces operational pressures without becoming a flashy arcade: decisions, clocks, incomplete information and crew coordination drive the scene.
